correctness.rationale: The map with b=-k,c=-h,d=5/4 reduces for each target (u,v) to two explicit quadratics g_v(y). Their active vertices are at y+=(da-kv)/(2dk)>0 iff v<K and y-=-(da+kv)/(2dk)<0 iff v>-K. The strict root-count intervals and their boundaries establish surjectivity and every exact fiber size 1,2,3. At u=v=0 there are exactly three regular preimages and determinants -ad,+ad,+ad. Direct differentiation gives det DF=h g_v'(y) on smooth branches, hence signed degree +1 for every regular target. Fold-to-crease distance identities are exact perfect squares. A standalone stdlib checker verifies rational boundaries and representative target fibers, but the universal statement rests on the complete algebraic monotonicity argument.
